packageRules.description: The supported Python floor is a project decision, not a dependency. Renovate reads it from .python-version and the setup-python pins in the workflows; both must be disabled or it will keep trying to drag the project to the newest interpreter.

Group non-major updates into a single PR. Nothing here merges itself: the integration tests skip without a cluster to point at, so a green run has not exercised the driver. Turn automerge on once CI runs them.

textual and its satellites are pinned to exact, version-coupled releases; upgrade them together by hand. This adapter gets them through harlequin, so the rule bites only if one is ever added directly.
